boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-admission campus activities, from public nature trails to Student Union games available with a valid UNF ID.

cards.title: Walk Goldenrod Trail
cards.subtitle: Robert W. Loftin Nature Trails, UNF
cards.notes: Meet at the trailhead for a 2.85-mile walk through varied habitats. Stay on the trail, bring water, and keep the group to fewer than 10 unless registered.
cards.short_summary: A long campus nature walk with birding potential.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF lists Goldenrod Trail as a 2.85-mile trail and includes it among activities that are free of charge; the nature trails are open to the public daily from sunrise to sunset.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public daily from sunrise to sunset. Groups of 10 or more require advance registration and a fee, so use this as a hang for fewer than 10 people.

cards.title: Loop Lake Oneida on Blueberry Trail
cards.subtitle: Robert W. Loftin Nature Trails, UNF
cards.notes: Take the 1.44-mile loop around Lake Oneida and pause at the exercise stations. Follow posted trail guidance and go with a buddy for a relaxed outing.
cards.short_summary: A lakeside trail loop with exercise stations.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF identifies Blueberry Trail as a 1.44-mile loop around Lake Oneida with exercise stations and includes it among activities that are free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Nature trails are open to the public daily from sunrise to sunset. Groups of 10 or more require advance registration and a fee.

cards.title: Stroll Gopher Tortoise Ridge
cards.subtitle: Robert W. Loftin Nature Trails, UNF
cards.notes: Use the short sandy route for a low-key wildlife walk. Look from a distance, leave plants and animals undisturbed, and respect every posted trail rule.
cards.short_summary: A short sandy route through tortoise habitat.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF describes Gopher Tortoise Ridge as a 0.78-mile sandy trail and includes it among activities that are free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Nature trails are open to the public daily from sunrise to sunset. Groups of 10 or more require advance registration and a fee.

cards.title: Find the Grandfather Cypress
cards.subtitle: Big Cyprus Trail, UNF
cards.notes: Walk the 0.47-mile connector loop with friends and look for the old cypress tree. Keep to the path and treat the surrounding habitat as a protected natural area.
cards.short_summary: A short connector loop past an old cypress tree.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF says Big Cyprus Trail is a 0.47-mile loop connecting Goldenrod and Blueberry trails and passing a campus grandfather cypress tree; it is listed among free activities.
cards.access_notes: Nature trails are open to the public daily from sunrise to sunset. Groups of 10 or more require advance registration and a fee.

cards.title: Take Red Maple Boardwalk
cards.subtitle: Robert W. Loftin Nature Trails, UNF
cards.notes: Choose this fully accessible 0.31-mile boardwalk for an easy group walk through Buckhead Branch Swamp. Keep voices low and follow posted natural-area guidance.
cards.short_summary: An accessible boardwalk through a campus swamp.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF describes Red Maple Boardwalk as a fully accessible 0.31-mile path through Buckhead Branch Swamp and lists it among activities free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Nature trails are open to the public daily from sunrise to sunset. Groups of 10 or more require advance registration and a fee.

cards.entity_name: Console Games at the Student Union Game Room
cards.title: Pick a Console Game
cards.subtitle: Student Union Game Room, Building 58
cards.notes: Bring a valid UNF ID and borrow a console game for a casual group session. Check the current reopening status before heading over because the room has summer renovations.
cards.short_summary: Campus console gaming with room-provided equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF calls the Student Union Game Room a free facility for UNF students, faculty, and staff and lists multiple console systems and games among its equipment.
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid UNF ID/Osprey1 Card. UNF states the Game Room is unavailable for Summer 2026 because of renovations; check its current status before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Board and Card Games at the Student Union Game Room
cards.title: Set Up a Board-Game Table
cards.subtitle: Student Union Game Room, Building 58
cards.notes: Use a valid UNF ID to check out a board or card game, then settle into the seating area. Return all borrowed equipment and leave the table ready for the next group.
cards.short_summary: A free indoor game session with board and card games.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF calls the Student Union Game Room a free facility for UNF students, faculty, and staff and lists board and card games, including Catan, chess, and Monopoly.
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid UNF ID/Osprey1 Card. UNF states the Game Room is unavailable for Summer 2026 because of renovations; check its current status before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Ping-pong at the Student Union Game Room
cards.title: Play Ping-pong Between Classes
cards.subtitle: Student Union Game Room, Building 58
cards.notes: Check out the table setup with a valid UNF ID for a few friendly rounds. Keep equipment attended, follow room rules, and leave time to return it before you go.
cards.short_summary: A quick table-game break in the Student Union.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF calls the Student Union Game Room a free facility for UNF students, faculty, and staff and lists ping-pong among its available equipment.
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid UNF ID/Osprey1 Card. UNF states the Game Room is unavailable for Summer 2026 because of renovations; check its current status before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Foosball at the Student Union Game Room
cards.title: Start a Foosball Match
cards.subtitle: Student Union Game Room, Building 58
cards.notes: Pair up for a short foosball match using the Game Room’s equipment. Bring a valid UNF ID, follow staff directions, and return checked-out items after the game.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost team game inside the Student Union.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF calls the Student Union Game Room a free facility for UNF students, faculty, and staff and lists foosball among its available equipment.
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid UNF ID/Osprey1 Card. UNF states the Game Room is unavailable for Summer 2026 because of renovations; check its current status before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Coloring Books at the Student Union Game Room
cards.title: Color and Catch Up
cards.subtitle: Student Union Game Room, Building 58
cards.notes: Borrow a coloring book with a valid UNF ID for a low-pressure indoor hang. Use the comfortable seating, keep materials together, and return borrowed equipment to staff.
cards.short_summary: A quiet creative break using Game Room materials.
cards.evidence_claim: UNF calls the Student Union Game Room a free facility for UNF students, faculty, and staff and lists coloring books among its available equipment.
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid UNF ID/Osprey1 Card. UNF states the Game Room is unavailable for Summer 2026 because of renovations; check its current status before visiting.
